# AffluentOS is Built & Ready for Operations

**AffluentOS** — the central business operations, CRM, sales pipeline, and consulting management platform for **The Affluentaccelerators** — is fully built, compiled, and operational.

> **Live Application URL:**  
> [https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/40b4be73-a887-4b81-81eb-ebca7696f21e/a53f7e4028b7f34005ed6843/](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/40b4be73-a887-4b81-81eb-ebca7696f21e/a53f7e4028b7f34005ed6843/)

---

### What Was Built:

#### 1. Brand Identity & SaaS Interface
- **Visual Palette:** Deep emerald green (`#064e3b` / `#043e2f`), subtle warm gold accents (`#d97706`), clean slate borders, and crisp cards inspired by Attio, Linear, and HubSpot CRM.
- **Tagline:** *"Your Business. Your People. Your Progress."*
- **Layout:** Collapsible responsive sidebar, contextual top navigation bar, global multi-entity search (`/`), notification center, and quick-action menu.

#### 2. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Interactive Role Switcher
Test and inspect the platform from any of the 6 roles via the top-bar dropdown:
- **Super Admin / Founder** (*Dr. Chukwuma Eze*): Unrestricted access to all data, pipelines, audit logs, team assignments, and system settings.
- **Administrator / Operations Manager** (*Amina Bello*): Inquiries triage, lead assignment, consultant coordination, and operational reports.
- **Business Development Manager** (*Tunde Adeyemi*): Lead generation, deal creation, activity logging, and commercial pipeline management.
- **Sales Representative** (*Chioma Okafor*): Assigned prospects, discovery calls, follow-ups, and proposal presentation.
- **Consultant / Business Analyst** (*David Adeleke, Ngozi Nwosu*): Assigned consulting engagements, diagnostic reports, task execution, and deliverables.
- **Fellow / Intern** (*Femi Alabi*): Research assignments, task status tracking, and deliverable submissions.

#### 3. Module One: Executive & Operations Dashboard
- **Real-Time KPI Cards:** Total Inquiries, New Inquiries This Month, Active Prospects, Qualified Leads, Active Pipeline Opportunities, Total Clients, Active Consulting Projects, Closed Won Deals, Closed Won Revenue (in NGN, e.g. ₦42.0M), and Overdue Follow-up alerts.
- **Live Recharts Visualizations:**
  - Sales Pipeline Value by Stage (Bar chart in ₦ Millions)
  - Lead Conversion Funnel (Inquiry → Contacted → Qualified → Proposals → Closed Won)
  - Inquiry Channels & Acquisition Sources (Website, Referral, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Direct Outreach)
  - Commercial Team Leaderboard (Activities vs Revenue Attributed)
- **"My Work Today" Actionable Workspace:** Follow-ups due today, overdue alerts with one-click completion, and active assigned deals.

#### 4. Module Two: Inquiry Management System
- **Categories Supported:** Business Audit Requests, Custom Business Consulting, Business Advisory, Business Strategy Requests, Business Growth Support, Business Development Requests, Partnership Inquiries, General Business Inquiries.
- **Unique References:** e.g. `AA-INQ-2026-0038`.
- **Views:** Dual **Table View** and **Kanban View** with search, filters (Status, Priority, Category, Assigned BD), and bulk assignment.
- **Inquiry Profile Slide-out (6 Comprehensive Tabs):**
  1. *Overview* (Contact details, requested service, budget, consultation method)
  2. *Business Diagnostics* (Stage, team size, model, revenue, current bottlenecks, objectives)
  3. *Uploaded Documents* (Matched Google Drive pitch decks, diagnostic spreadsheets)
  4. *Activities & Timeline* (Chronological touchpoints)
  5. *Internal Notes* (Team strategy discussions)
  6. *Audit History* (Assignment and status audit trail)
- **Actions:** Quick status mover, schedule follow-up, WhatsApp client shortcut, and *Qualify & Convert to Deal*.

#### 5. Module Three: Google Sheets & Google Drive Integration
- **OAuth 2.0 Integration Status:** Connected to `integrations@affluentaccelerators.com`.
- **Spreadsheet & Folder:** Target sheet *"The Affluentaccelerators - Website Leads & Diagnostic Inquiries 2026"* and Drive folder *"AffluentOS Website Submissions & Client Diagnostic Files"*.
- **Spreadsheet Column Mapping:** Dynamic mapping of sheet headers to AffluentOS internal fields.
- **Interactive Actions:**
  - *Run Manual Sync Now*: Fetches rows from Google Sheets, matches Drive attachments, and updates logs.
  - *Historical Batch Import*: Imports archived website submissions without duplicates.
  - *Direct Webhook Endpoint*: `https://api.affluentaccelerators.com/v1/integrations/google-sheets/webhook` with one-click copy.
  - *Sync Logs*: Detailed sync audit trail showing success/skipped counts and timestamps.

#### 6. Module Four: CRM / Contact & Organisation Directory
- Directory of founders, decision-makers, and organisations.
- Contact types: Prospect, Qualified Lead, Active Client, Former Client, Business Partner, Strategic Partner.
- **Duplicate Detection & Merge Engine:** Identifies potential duplicate contacts by email, phone, or company name with a safe one-click merge tool.

#### 7. Module Five: Sales Pipeline & Deal Management
- Pipedrive / HubSpot style Kanban pipeline across 9 stages: *New Lead, Initial Contact, Discovery, Qualified Opportunity, Consultation Scheduled, Proposal / Recommendation, Negotiation, Closed Won, Closed Lost*.
- Stage headers calculating total deal count and stage value in NGN.
- Weighted pipeline calculation and win rate tracking.
- **Closed Lost Reason Modal:** Captures objections (Budget constraints, timing, competitor, price objections) for root-cause analysis.
- **Closed Won Prompt:** Moving a deal to Closed Won automatically prompts creation of a consulting engagement.

#### 8. Module Six: BD Activity & Follow-up Workspace
- Dedicated workspace for BD managers and sales reps.
- Follow-up Queues: *Due Today*, *Overdue (prominently highlighted)*, *Upcoming*, and *Completed*.
- One-click *Record Outcome & Complete* with immediate prompt to schedule the next follow-up.
- Activity logger for Calls, WhatsApp chats, Discovery sessions, Proposals, and Notes.

#### 9. Module Seven & Eight: Consulting Engagements & Consultant Directory
- **Project Records:** Project reference (e.g. `AA-PRJ-2026-0012`), Scope of Work, Deliverables tracker, milestone progress bar.
- **Interactive Task Management:** Assign tasks to Lead Consultant, Business Analyst, or Fellow with status progression (`todo` → `in_progress` → `review` → `done`), which dynamically updates the overall engagement progress percentage.
- **Consultant Workload Management:** Directory cards with profile photo, experience level, specialisations, skills, and current workload score (0–100%) for fair distribution.

#### 10. Module Nine & Ten: Reports, Document Vault, Notifications & Settings
- **Reports & Business Intelligence:** Closed revenue by practice area, consultant utilisation chart, lost-deal root cause analysis, and one-click CSV report exports.
- **Document Vault:** Centralized view of all pitch decks, diagnostic files, and deliverables synced from Google Drive.
- **Notification Center:** Filterable by Inquiries, Deals, Follow-ups, and Projects with quick jump links.
- **Settings & Audit Trail:** Company branding tokens, database RBAC matrix, and complete system audit log.

### 🌐 Live Application Link

You can view and test the updated, mobile-responsive AffluentOS platform here:
👉 **[Open AffluentOS Live Preview](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/40b4be73-a887-4b81-81eb-ebca7696f21e/a53f7e4028b7f34005ed6843/)**

*(Note: If you'd like to push this codebase to your own GitHub repository, tap the **GitHub mark at the top of the chat** to connect your repo — your complete commit history and code will sync there automatically).*

---

### 1. Mobile Responsiveness Enhancements

The entire application has been re-architected to deliver a native app-like experience on smartphones (tested down to 375px viewport width) while maintaining high-density desktop productivity:

1. **Slide-Out Mobile Drawer Navigation ([`Sidebar.tsx`](file:///home/agent/workspace/src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx)):**
   - Collapses into an off-canvas drawer on mobile (`< 768px`) with an animated dark backdrop and tap-to-close dismiss button.
   - Preserves quick role indicator and system version badges.

2. **Mobile Bottom Navigation Bar ([`MobileBottomNav.tsx`](file:///home/agent/workspace/src/components/layout/MobileBottomNav.tsx)):**
   - Pinned thumb-friendly bottom bar providing one-touch navigation to **Overview**, **Inquiries** (with live unread badge), **Sales Deals**, **Follow-ups** (with flashing overdue alert indicator), and **Menu Drawer**.
   - Added adaptive padding (`pb-20 md:pb-12` in [`App.tsx`](file:///home/agent/workspace/src/App.tsx)) ensuring bottom nav never obscures inputs, action buttons, or table rows.

3. **Responsive Top Navigation ([`TopNav.tsx`](file:///home/agent/workspace/src/components/layout/TopNav.tsx)):**
   - Hamburger icon on mobile headers for quick drawer toggling.
   - Compact Google Sheet sync status pill (`Connected`).
   - Touch-friendly "+ New" quick action drawer and user profile modal trigger.

4. **Adaptive KPI Cards & Visualizations ([`ExecutiveDashboard.tsx`](file:///home/agent/workspace/src/components/dashboard/ExecutiveDashboard.tsx)):**
   - KPI values now scale dynamically (`text-lg sm:text-xl lg:text-2xl font-mono truncate`) to prevent text wrapping or layout overflow on compact screens.
   - Kanban boards across **Sales Pipeline** and **Inquiries** feature horizontal touch swiping with snap scrolling.

---

### 2. Requirements to Take AffluentOS Live to Production

Inside the application, navigate to **Settings ➔ Production Guide** to view and copy all deployment configurations, ready-to-run SQL schemas, and Google Apps Script triggers.

Here is the exact production architecture:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Public Website Inquiry Form"] -->|"Submits Entry"| B["Google Sheets & Google Drive"]
    B -->|"Apps Script onFormSubmit Trigger"| C["AffluentOS Ingestion Webhook"]
    C -->|"Validates Signature & Stores"| D[("Supabase PostgreSQL DB")]
    E["Staff Signup / Login"] -->|"Checks Whitelist & Corporate Domain"| F{"Authorized Staff?"}
    F -->|"Yes (Role Assigned)"| G["AffluentOS Dashboard"]
    F -->|"No"| H["Access Denied / Account Locked"]
```

---

#### A. User Authentication by Whitelist ("Auth by List")
Because AffluentOS is a confidential internal tool for The Affluentaccelerators, public signups must be strictly gated:

1. **Staff Whitelist System ([`SettingsView.tsx`](file:///home/agent/workspace/src/components/settings/SettingsView.tsx)):**
   - Managed under **Settings ➔ Staff Whitelist & Accounts**.
   - Super Admins can add team emails, assign default roles (`super_admin`, `admin`, `bd_manager`, `sales_rep`, `consultant`, `intern`), and activate or deactivate accounts with a single toggle.
2. **Signup & Login Gate ([`AuthView.tsx`](file:///home/agent/workspace/src/components/auth/AuthView.tsx)):**
   - Users can only sign up if their email address is either pre-authorized in the whitelist OR has a `@affluentaccelerators.com` corporate email.
   - Any unauthorized email trying to sign up is immediately blocked by a PostgreSQL database trigger (`public.handle_new_staff_signup()`).
3. **Session & Profile Management ([`UserProfileModal.tsx`](file:///home/agent/workspace/src/components/auth/UserProfileModal.tsx)):**
   - Users can update their avatar, phone, and password, and view active session details directly in their profile panel.

---

#### B. The Forms and Google Sheet Data Pipeline

To automatically pull inquiries from your existing Google Forms and Google Sheets into AffluentOS:

1. **Google Apps Script Webhook:**
   - In your Google Sheet, open **Extensions ➔ Apps Script**.
   - Paste the webhook script provided in the in-app **Production Guide** (`Code.gs`).
   - Add a trigger: **`onFormSubmit`** ➔ **Event Source: From spreadsheet** ➔ **Event type: On form submit**.
2. **Google Drive Attachment Matching:**
   - When users upload business diagnostic files, pitch decks, or financial statements via Google Forms, the Apps Script captures the Google Drive sharing URLs (`drive.google.com/file/d/...`).
   - AffluentOS automatically categorizes and links these documents under the inquiry record and displays them in the **Documents** repository.
3. **Two-Way Synchronization:**
   - AffluentOS includes a manual **Sync Now** button and an automated polling interval (`5m`, `15m`, `1h`) to fetch new submissions or changes made directly in the spreadsheet.

---

#### C. Database Setup (Supabase / PostgreSQL)

1. Create a free or paid project on [Supabase](https://supabase.com).
2. Go to the **SQL Editor** in Supabase and run the SQL migration script from the in-app **Production Guide**:
   - Creates the `authorized_staff`, `profiles`, `inquiries`, `deals`, `activities`, and `audit_logs` tables.
   - Enables **Row-Level Security (RLS)** so consultants only see assigned projects, sales reps only see their deals, and Super Admins retain full company-wide visibility.

---

#### D. Production Deployment Checklist & Environment Variables

Host the frontend on Vercel, Netlify, or Cloudflare Pages:

```bash
# Production Environment Variables (.env.production)
VITE_SUPABASE_URL=https://your-project.supabase.co
VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=eyJh...your-anon-key
AFFLUENTOS_API_SECRET=affluent_secret_live_prod_2026
VITE_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID=1A2B3C...your-sheet-id
VITE_GOOGLE_API_KEY=AIzaSy...your-google-api-key
```

- **Custom Domain:** Point your DNS (e.g., `affluentos.affluentaccelerators.com` or `app.affluentaccelerators.com`) via CNAME to your hosting provider with automatic SSL.
